ConnectionStrings._comment: Db is blank on purpose - it holds a password. Azure: App Service > Environment variables > ConnectionStrings__Db. Local: dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:Db" "<connection string>".

Jwt._comment: Key is blank on purpose. Azure: App Service > Configuration > Jwt__Key. Local: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "<32+ random chars>".
